correctness.rationale: All length-2h even words with h<=3 split into two anagrams and D_h acts as all permutations for h<=3. All 24 equal-Parikh splits of the eight-letter witness 00011022 yield 0012 versus 0102, whose two zeros are respectively adjacent and opposite on the 4-cycle, an exact D4 invariant. An exhaustive deterministic Python 3 verifier enumerates all 6561 indexed ternary length-eight words and all their position splits, independently tests the D4 orbit invariant for Parikh(4,2,2), enumerates all smaller words, counts 48 failures and compares their complete set to the 48-element witness orbit. Program executed successfully on actual package content; finite domain fully checked; no infinite-length claim.

originality.rationale: The original 2023 manuscript (arXiv:2308.13882, Conjecture 2) and accessible 2024 revision state the universal ternary dihedral assertion directly contradicted by the explicit word 00011022. Its separately proved binary cyclic result concerns a strictly smaller alphabet and does not cover this failure. The inspected later 2025 shuffle-square paper studies ordinary shuffle squares of a different type, not the ternary dihedral conjecture. published-finding corpus and targeted publication searches did not show a covering finding. This is a positive comparison against published conjecture, not an inference that unsuccessful searching proves global novelty.
